categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies `WaitAndCreateNewBlock` in `src/node/block_template_manager.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Switches `WaitAndCreateNewBlock` from wall clock time to steady clock so timeout durations are not distorted by wall clock jumps or test mocktime. While a genuine bug in template update timing logic, its impact is limited to waitNext intervals during clock shifts and test execution.
